moduleInfo.moduleName: HiAnime.ms — Hybrid Web Player + Native Placeholder (Readable)
moduleInfo.moduleDesc: HiAnime.ms native browse with dynamic AniList ID mapping, functional Vidnest web-player entries, and preserved native resolver placeholders.
moduleInfo.changelog: Formatting-only cleanup: pretty-printed the module JSON and normalized all embedded JavaScript blocks into readable multi-line sections. Playback and navigation behavior remain the same as v1.21.

resolverInfo.developer: Preserved native-player placeholder. It receives a dynamic Vidnest web route but cannot become native playback until an authorized direct media endpoint is available.
